description: This file defines a Go package 'args' that provides a struct 'Args' for handling command-line arguments for the applyconfiguration generator, including default values, flag parsing, and validation.

classes.name: Args
classes.description: A wrapper for arguments to applyconfiguration-gen, holding configuration options such as output directory, package, header file, external apply configurations, and schema path.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Returns default arguments for the generator, initializing ExternalApplyConfigurations with common meta/v1 types.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags to a FlagSet for configuring the Args fields, including output directory, package, header file, external configurations, and schema path.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks that required arguments --output-dir and --output-pkg are provided.
